question: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on?
sql:
WITH page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.page.pagePath,
    h.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX LIKE '201701%'
  AND LOWER(t.trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    ph.pagePath AS home_page,
    ph.time AS home_time,
    ph.fullVisitorId,
    ph.visitId,
    ph.hitNumber,
    ph.rn,
    LEAD(ph.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.fullVisitorId, ph.visitId ORDER BY ph.hitNumber) AS next_page_path,
    LEAD(ph.time) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.fullVisitorId, ph.visitId ORDER BY ph.hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM page_hits ph
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE home_page = '/home'
),
time_spent AS (
  SELECT 
    home_page,
    next_page_path,
    SAFE_DIVIDE((next_time - home_time), 1000) AS time_seconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_page_path, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM time_spent
  GROUP BY next_page_path
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(time_seconds) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM time_spent
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT next_page_path FROM next_page_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST(max_time_seconds AS INT64) AS max_time_seconds
FROM max_time
